script_text: Stop, Pisces — Neptune is squaring your natal Sun in the 1st House right now, flooding your identity with confusion and emotional fog. The Water element is surging through your 7th House of Partnerships. Venus forms a trine to your co-ruler Jupiter, pulling someone from your past back into your orbit. If you're single, this is the energy to let vulnerability lead — authentic openness will magnetize someone who matches your depth. If you're taken, watch for unspoken resentments surfacing during late-night conversations. A conjunction of Mercury and Saturn in your 10th House of Public Status is demanding you prove your worth through quiet competence, not flashy gestures. The blessing arriving this week is an unexpected financial windfall tied to a creative project you abandoned months ago. Don't second-guess your intuition — it's sharper than it's been in years. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
